Criterion: SWE-bench Verified resolution rate; cost by input tokens/USD. Agent = authors' re-implemented DirectSolve (no commercial agent), temperature 0.8, single run
- DirectSolve no-minification + GPT-5-mini (full benchmark): 252 resolved (50.0%), avg input 90,535 tokens (SD 16,795). Quality partly, cost partly
- DirectSolve + minification (all except dedent) + GPT-5-mini (full): 188 resolved (38.0%), avg input 52,776 (SD 13,697), -42% tokens. Quality partly, cost works. By difficulty: <15 min 65.0 -> 48.0%; 15 min-1 h 45.0 -> 35.0%; 1-4 h 19.0 -> 7.0%; >4 h 0 -> 0% (token reduction 39.4-42.8%)
- Single-transformation ablations + GPT-4.1 (100 instances): no-minification 46% / 87,325 tokens / $0.1867; remove-imports 39% / $0.1775; merge-imports 45% / $0.1838; remove-blank-lines 41% / $0.1834; remove-comments 45% / 77,849 / $0.1674; remove-docstrings 43% / 68,202 / $0.1475; dedent 36% / $0.1828; reduce-operators 41% / 80,132 / $0.1715; short-vars 38%; short-funcs 42%; short-classes 45%; short-vars-map 43%; short-funcs-map 47%; short-classes-map 46% (ablation)
- Stacked transformations + GPT-4.1 and + GPT-5-mini (100 instances): values in Fig. 3 only; text: with dedent resolution falls to 27% vs 47% baseline (model not specified) (ablation)

Tasks: SWE-bench Verified (full for GPT-5-mini; 100-instance subset for ablations). Configurations: no-minification baseline vs minification (combined, single, stacked). Held constant: agent implementation, model per comparison, temperature 0.8, 100k repair budget, preprocessing (tests, docs, build files excluded), tokenizer. Acceptance tests: SWE-bench harness. Repetitions: single run per configuration. Human intervention: none

Minification cuts input tokens by 42% (about 93% of repair cost is input) with a 12 pp drop in resolution (50.0% -> 38.0%) on GPT-5-mini; drop consistent across difficulty (10-17 pp) and mostly 10-20 pp across repositories (outlier psf/requests 75 -> 25%). Remove-docstrings gives lowest cost ($0.1475 vs $0.1867) at -3 pp; dedent worst (-10 pp; resolved set a strict subset of baseline). No significance tests. Replication: 50.0% vs 50.8% reported for DirectSolve with Gemini-2.5-Pro

Distinguished transformations on cost; small resolution differences within run-to-run variability, which authors acknowledge (variation across runs observed, single run per configuration). Limitations stated: stochastic variability, single code-heavy agent, test-based validity only, formatting artefacts in diffs

Stochastic variability (file selection differs between runs; multiple runs needed); single agent heavy on code input, may not generalise; patch validity only by tests (no human check); REPLACE blocks keep minified formatting (formatter or source maps needed); dedent needs indentation post-processing
